    def _startup_playable(self):
        """Resolve only the configured stream, never refresh portal catalogs here.

        Return a Kodi ListItem with the provider URL in its path. The caller
        decides whether Kodi expects a resolved playable item or a direct play.
        """
        from live_timing import begin,emit
        timing=begin(self)
        from portals import get_by_id
        p = get_by_id(self._params.get('pid', ''))
        if not p or p.get('type') != 'xtream' or not p.get('start_stream_id'):
            notify('XCMate', 'Bitte zuerst eine Startgruppe und einen Startsender wählen.')
            return None
        from xtream import XtreamClient
        from player import build_playable_item
        sid = str(p['start_stream_id'])
        xc = XtreamClient(p['xc_host'], p['xc_user'], p['xc_pass'])
        from live_start import channel as start_channel
        if hasattr(self,'_start_channel'):
            channel = self._start_channel
        else:
            emit(timing,'PORTAL_REQUEST_BEGIN',network=0)
            channel = start_channel(p,xc)
            emit(timing,'PORTAL_REQUEST_END',network=0)
        if channel is None:
            notify('XCMate', 'Startsender ist nicht im aktivierten lokalen Katalog verfügbar.')
            return None
        emit(timing,'START_SID_RESOLVED',ready=1)
        url = xc.live_stream_url(sid, 'ts')
        if not url:
            notify('XCMate', 'Die Startsender-Adresse konnte nicht ermittelt werden.')
            return None
        title = channel.get('name') or 'Startsender'
        item = build_playable_item(url, title=title,
                                   logo=channel.get('stream_icon', ''),live67=True)
        return p, sid, title, item

    def _play_start(self):
        """Kodi playable menu entry: resolve, never open an empty directory.

        A ListItem with IsPlayable=true invokes Kodi's playback handshake.
        Calling Player.play() here leaves the pending plugin URL unresolved.
        """
        from live_exit import _trace
        _trace('START_RESOLVER')
        prepared = self._startup_playable()
        if prepared is None:
            xbmcplugin.setResolvedUrl(self._handle, False, xbmcgui.ListItem())
            return
        p, sid, title, item = prepared
        from live_overlay import announce
        try:
            session=announce(p['id'], sid, title)
            from live_timing import bind,emit
            bind(self._live_timing,session)
            from play_intent import before_play
            if not before_play(session):
                xbmcplugin.setResolvedUrl(self._handle, False, xbmcgui.ListItem())
                return
            from live_recovery import tag_live_item
            tag_live_item(item,session)
            xbmcgui.Window(10000).setProperty(
                'XtreamMate.StartupStatus', 'Kodi-Auflösung: ' + title[:64])
            emit(self._live_timing,'PLAY_INVOKED')
            xbmcplugin.setResolvedUrl(self._handle, True, item)
        except Exception as exc:
            error('XCMate startup resolver failed: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__))
            notify('XCMate', 'Startsender konnte nicht gestartet werden.')
            xbmcgui.Window(10000).setProperty(
                'XtreamMate.StartupStatus', 'Fehler: ' + type(exc).__name__)
            xbmcplugin.setResolvedUrl(self._handle, False, xbmcgui.ListItem())

    def _play_start_direct(self):
        """RunPlugin-only direct startup with fresh ownership checks."""
        from app_entry import accept_play,still_allowed
        if not accept_play(self._params):return

        from live_exit import _trace
        _trace('START_RESOLVER')
        prepared = self._startup_playable()
        if prepared is None:
            return
        p, sid, title, item = prepared
        if not still_allowed(self._params):return
        from live_overlay import announce
        try:
            session=announce(p['id'], sid, title)
            from live_timing import bind,emit
            bind(self._live_timing,session)
            from play_intent import before_play
            if not before_play(session): return
            if not still_allowed(self._params):
                xbmcgui.Window(10000).setProperty('XCMate.PrePlay.Cancel',session['nonce'])
                xbmcgui.Window(10000).setProperty('XtreamMate.StartupStatus','AUTOPLAY_BLOCKED_FOREIGN_OR_PREFERENCE')
                return
            from live_recovery import tag_live_item
            tag_live_item(item,session)
            xbmcgui.Window(10000).setProperty(
                'XtreamMate.StartupStatus', 'Autoplay-Direktstart: ' + title[:64])
            emit(self._live_timing,'PLAY_INVOKED')
            xbmc.Player().play(item.getPath(), item)
        except Exception as exc:
            error('XCMate direct startup failed: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__))
            notify('XCMate', 'Startsender konnte nicht gestartet werden.')
            xbmcgui.Window(10000).setProperty(
                'XtreamMate.StartupStatus', 'Fehler: ' + type(exc).__name__)

    def _m3u_section_groups(self, section: str):
        from iptv import load_m3u, group_channels, split_m3u_sections
        p = self._portal()
        if not p:
            return
        pid      = p['id']
        m3u_url  = p.get('m3u_url', '').strip()
        if not m3u_url:
            notify(_L(32000), _L(32049))
            xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle, False)
            return

        all_ch   = load_m3u(m3u_url, portal_id=pid)
        sections = split_m3u_sections(all_ch)
        channels = sections.get(section, [])

        if not channels:
            notify(_L(32000), _L(32055, section.title()))
            xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle, False)
            return

        label   = _L(32002) if section == 'movies' else _L(32003)
        content = 'movies' if section == 'movies' else 'tvshows'
        xbmcplugin.setPluginCategory(self._handle, f'{p["name"]} – {label}')
        xbmcplugin.setContent(self._handle, content)

        groups  = group_channels(channels)
        g_list  = sorted(groups) if setting_int('sort_groups') == 1 else list(groups)
        g_list  = apply_lang_sort(g_list, name_fn=lambda g: g, group_fn=lambda g: g)

        action = 'm3u_movie_list' if section == 'movies' else 'm3u_series_list'
        for gname in g_list:
            count = len(groups[gname])
            self._add_dir(f'{gname}  [{count}]',
                          self.url(action=action, pid=pid, group=gname),
                          icon=_ICON_VOD if section == 'movies'
                               else _ICON_SERIES)

        xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle, succeeded=True, updateListing=False, cacheToDisc=False)

    def _live_channels(self):
        p = self._portal()
        if not p:
            return
        group   = self._params.get('group', '')
        page    = int(self._params.get('page', 0))
        psize   = setting_int('items_per_page', 50)
        all_ch  = self._load_channels(p)
        if p.get('type') == 'xtream':
            from group_selection import filter_channels
            all_ch = filter_channels(all_ch, p['id'])
        ch_list = [c for c in all_ch if c.group == group] if group else all_ch

        s = setting_int('sort_channels')
        if s == 1:
            ch_list.sort(key=lambda c: c.name.lower())
        elif s == 2:
            ch_list.sort(key=lambda c: c.name.lower(), reverse=True)
        ch_list = apply_lang_sort(ch_list)

        total   = len(ch_list)
        chunk   = ch_list[page * psize:(page + 1) * psize]

        xbmcplugin.setContent(self._handle, 'videos')
        label = group or _L(32015)
        if total > psize:
            label = f'{label}  ({page * psize + 1}-{min((page + 1) * psize, total)} / {total})'
        xbmcplugin.setPluginCategory(self._handle, label)

        ptype   = p.get('type', 'm3u')
        from player import channel_list_item
        from epg import load_cache
        from epg_views import resolve_guide, prefetch_short_guides
        guide = load_cache(p['id'])
        xc_epg = self._xc(p) if ptype == 'xtream' else None
        manual_epg = {}
        if xc_epg:
            from epg_sources import configuration
            manual_epg = configuration(p['id'])['mappings']
            prefetch_short_guides(p, chunk,view_path=self.url(action='live_channels',
                                  pid=p['id'],group=group,page=page))
        now = time.time()
        matched=now_count=next_count=0
        for ch in chunk:
            li = channel_list_item(ch)
            epg = resolve_guide(guide, ch.tvg_id, ch.extra.get('stream_id',''),
                                now, xc_epg, manual_epg)
            now_count+=bool(epg['now'])
            next_count+=bool(epg['next'])
            matched+=bool(epg['now'] or epg['next'])
            from epg_views import programme_plot
            li.setInfo('video', {'title':ch.name, 'plot':programme_plot(epg),
                                 'mediatype':'video'})
            if epg['now'] or epg['next']:
                li.setLabel('{}  |  Jetzt: {}  |  Danach: {}'.format(
                    ch.name, '{}-{} {}'.format(epg['now_time'],epg['now_end_time'],epg['now'])
                    if epg['now'] else 'Keine EPG-Daten',epg['next'] or '–'))

            if ptype == 'stb':
                play_url  = self.url(action='play_stb_live', pid=p['id'],
                                     cmd=ch.url, name=ch.name, logo=ch.logo)
                cu_action = 'stb_catchup_list'
            else:
                play_url  = self.url(action='play_live', pid=p['id'],
                                     sid=ch.extra.get('stream_id', ''),
                                     url=ch.url, name=ch.name, logo=ch.logo)
                cu_action = 'catchup_list'

            sid = str(ch.extra.get('stream_id', ''))
            epg_link_id = manual_epg.get(sid) or ch.tvg_id or sid
            cm = [
                (('Remove from Favourites' if is_favourite(ch.url)
                  else 'Add to Favourites'),
                 f'RunPlugin({self.url(action="toggle_favourite", url=ch.url, name=ch.name, logo=ch.logo, group=ch.group)})'),
                ('EPG',
                 f'Container.Update({self.url(action="epg_channel", pid=p["id"], sid=sid, tvg_id=epg_link_id, name=ch.name)})'),
                ('EPG-/Live-Diagnose',f'RunPlugin({self.url(action="remote_diagnostics")})'),
            ]
            if ch.catchup or ch.catchup_days:
                cm.append((_L(32009),
                            f'Container.Update({self.url(action=cu_action, pid=p["id"], url=ch.url, name=ch.name, tvg_id=ch.tvg_id)})'))
            li.addContextMenuItems(cm)
            xbmcplugin.addDirectoryItem(self._handle, play_url, li, False)

    
        if page > 0:
            self._add_dir(_L(32019, page),
                          self.url(action='live_channels', pid=p['id'],
                                   group=group, page=page - 1),
                          icon=_ICON_SETTINGS)
        if (page + 1) * psize < total:
            remaining = total - (page + 1) * psize
            self._add_dir(_L(32018, remaining),
                          self.url(action='live_channels', pid=p['id'],
                                   group=group, page=page + 1),
                          icon=_ICON_SETTINGS)

        from live_diagnostics import record
        record('epg_list','RENDERED',visible=len(chunk),matched=matched,
               now_count=now_count,next_count=next_count,channels=len(guide),
               programmes=sum(len(v) for v in guide.values() if isinstance(v,list)))
        xbmcplugin.addSortMethod(self._handle, xbmcplugin.SORT_METHOD_NONE)
        xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle, succeeded=True, updateListing=False, cacheToDisc=False)

    @staticmethod
    def _play_youtube_id(vid):
        from metadata_views import trailer_id
        from urllib.parse import quote
        if trailer_id({'youtube_trailer':vid}) != vid:
            return
        try:
            xbmcaddon.Addon('plugin.video.youtube')
        except RuntimeError:
            xbmcgui.Dialog().ok('XCMate',
                'Bitte das offizielle Kodi-YouTube-Add-on installieren, '
                'um Trailer direkt wiederzugeben.')
            return
        xbmc.executebuiltin('PlayMedia(plugin://plugin.video.youtube/play/?video_id={})'.format(quote(vid)))

    def _recent_media(self, action, kind):
        """Widget-ready Kodi directory populated from the cached Xtream index.

        Neither the home screen nor the latest view blocks on Xtream requests.
        The Kodi service warms the catalog in the background; refresh from
        the portal home is available if the IPTV provider has added new titles.
        """
        p = self._portal()
        if not p:
            return
        wanted = 'include_vod' if kind == 'vod' else 'include_series'
        if p.get('type') != 'xtream' or not p.get(wanted, True):
            xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle, False)
            return
        from group_selection import filter_entries
        from latest_media import first_seen, recent_entries
        from player import vod_list_item, series_list_item
        xc = self._xc(p)
        title = 'Neueste Filme' if kind == 'vod' else 'Neueste Serien'
        xbmcplugin.setPluginCategory(self._handle, '{} – {}'.format(p['name'], title))
        xbmcplugin.setContent(self._handle, 'movies' if kind == 'vod' else 'tvshows')
        all_items = xc.get_cached_catalog(action) if xc else None
        if not isinstance(all_items, list):
            self._add_dir('Katalog wird im Hintergrund geladen – später erneut öffnen',
                          self.url(action='portal_home', pid=p['id']),
                          icon=_ICON_SETTINGS,
                          plot='Beim ersten Scan muss XCMate Daten vom Anbieter laden.')
        else:
            # Cache was present before 0.1.5: initialize its discovery baseline
            # without falsely flagging all previously known items as 'new'.
            seen = first_seen(xc._cache_key(action), action, all_items)
            items = filter_entries(all_items, p['id'], kind)
            recent = recent_entries(items, action, seen, limit=50)
            for item in recent:
                if kind == 'vod':
                    sid = item.get('stream_id', '')
                    li = vod_list_item(item)
                    self._add_media_context(li, item, 'vod', sid, p['id'])
                    url = self.url(action='play_vod', pid=p['id'],
                                   stream_id=sid,
                                   ext=item.get('container_extension', 'mkv'),
                                   title=item.get('name', ''),
                                   logo=item.get('stream_icon', ''))
                    is_folder = False
                else:
                    sid = item.get('series_id', '')
                    li = series_list_item(item)
                    self._add_media_context(li, item, 'series', sid, p['id'])
                    url = self.url(action='series_seasons', pid=p['id'],
                                   series_id=sid, title=item.get('name', ''))
                    is_folder = True
                xbmcplugin.addDirectoryItem(self._handle, url, li, is_folder)
            if not recent:
                self._add_dir('Noch keine neu hinzugefügten Titel erkennbar',
                              self.url(action='portal_home', pid=p['id']),
                              icon=_ICON_SETTINGS,
                              plot='Der Anbieter liefert eventuell kein Hinzufügedatum. '
                                   'XCMate erkennt künftig beim Aktualisieren neue IDs.')
        xbmcplugin.addSortMethod(self._handle, xbmcplugin.SORT_METHOD_NONE)
        xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle, cacheToDisc=False)

    def _stb_catchup_list(self):
        p = self._portal()
        if not p:
            return
        cmd    = self._params.get('cmd', '')
        name   = self._params.get('name', '')
        tvg_id = self._params.get('tvg_id', '')
        xbmcplugin.setContent(self._handle, 'videos')
        xbmcplugin.setPluginCategory(self._handle, f'{_L(32009)} – {name}')
        now     = time.time()
        days    = max(1, setting_int('epg_hours_back', 72) // 24)
        from_ts = now - days * 86400
        prgs    = []
        mgr = self._epg_mgr(p)
        if mgr:
            prgs = mgr.get_range(tvg_id, from_ts, now)
        if not prgs and tvg_id:
            stb = self._stb(p)
            if stb:
                for e in stb.get_short_epg(tvg_id, count=50):
                    try:
                        s = int(e.get('start_timestamp', e.get('time', 0)))
                        q = int(e.get('stop_timestamp',  e.get('time_to', 0)))
                        if s and q and q < now:
                            from epg import Programme
                            prgs.append(Programme(
                                channel=tvg_id, start=s, stop=q,
                                title=e.get('name', ''), desc=e.get('descr', '')
                            ))
                    except Exception:
                        pass
        if not prgs:
            notify(_L(32009), _L(32047))
            xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle)
            return
        import datetime as _dt
        for pr in sorted(prgs, key=lambda x: x.start, reverse=True):
            dt_s = _dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(pr.start).strftime('%d/%m  %H:%M')
            li   = xbmcgui.ListItem(f'{dt_s}   {pr.title}')
            li.setInfo('video', {
                'title': pr.title, 'plot': pr.desc,
                'duration': max(0, pr.stop - pr.start), 'mediatype': 'video',
            })
            li.setProperty('IsPlayable', 'true')
            xbmcplugin.addDirectoryItem(
                self._handle,
                self.url(action='play_stb_catchup', pid=p['id'],
                         cmd=cmd, name=pr.title,
                         start=int(pr.start), stop=int(pr.stop)),
                li, False
            )
        xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle)

    def _stb_account(self):
        p = self._portal()
        if not p:
            return
        stb    = self._stb(p)
        info_d = stb.get_account_info() if stb else {}
        lines = [
            f'Portal:  {p["name"]}',
            f'MAC:     {p.get("stb_mac", "")}',
        ]
        _status = info_d.get('status', '')
        if _status:
            lines.append(f'Status:  {_status}')
        _pv2 = info_d.get('phone', '')
        _end = info_d.get('end_date', '')
        if _pv2:
            import re as _re2
            _pv2_norm = _re2.sub(r'\b(am|pm)\b', lambda m: m.group().upper(), _pv2.strip(), flags=_re2.IGNORECASE)
            _matched2 = False
            for _fmt2 in ('%B %d, %Y, %I:%M %p', '%B %d, %Y, %-I:%M %p', '%B %d, %Y',
                          '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', '%Y-%m-%d', '%d.%m.%Y'):
                try:
                    import datetime as _dtp3
                    _exp2 = _dtp3.datetime.strptime(_pv2_norm, _fmt2)
                    _days2 = (_exp2 - _dtp3.datetime.now()).days
                    lines.append(f'Läuft ab: {_exp2.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M")}  ({_days2} Tage)')
                    _matched2 = True
                    break
                except Exception:
                    pass
            if not _matched2:
                lines.append(f'Läuft ab: {_pv2}')
        elif _end:
            try:
                import datetime as _dtp4
                _exp3 = _dtp4.datetime.strptime(_end[:10], '%Y-%m-%d')
                _days3 = (_exp3 - _dtp4.datetime.now()).days
                lines.append(f'Läuft ab: {_exp3.strftime("%d.%m.%Y")}  ({_days3} Tage)')
            except Exception:
                lines.append(f'Läuft ab: {_end}')
        _pkg = info_d.get('tariff_plan_name', '')
        if _pkg:
            lines.append(f'Paket:    {_pkg}')
        _mc = info_d.get('max_connections', '')
        if _mc:
            lines.append(f'Max conn: {_mc}')
        xbmcgui.Dialog().ok(_L(32013), '\n'.join(lines))
        xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle)

        query = self._params.get('q', '')
        pid   = self._params.get('pid', '')
        if not query:
            xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle)
            return
        xbmcplugin.setContent(self._handle, 'videos')
        xbmcplugin.setPluginCategory(self._handle, f'{_L(32005)}: {query}')
        import portals as P
        from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
        search_list = [P.get_by_id(pid)] if pid else P.get_active()
        search_list = [x for x in search_list if x]

        all_items = []
        workers   = min(len(search_list), 6)
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers) as pool:
            futures = {pool.submit(self._search_in_portal_collect, p, query): p
                       for p in search_list}
            for fut in as_completed(futures):
                try:
                    all_items.extend(fut.result())
                except Exception as e:
                    error(f'search thread error: {e}')

        all_items = apply_lang_sort(
            all_items,
            name_fn=lambda x: x[1].getLabel(),
            group_fn=lambda x: ''
        )
        for url, li, is_folder in all_items:
            xbmcplugin.addDirectoryItem(self._handle, url, li, is_folder)

        if not all_items:
            notify(_L(32005), _L(32046, query))
        xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle)

    def _search_in_portal(self, p: dict, query: str) -> int:
        items = self._search_in_portal_collect(p, query)
        for url, li, is_folder in items:
            xbmcplugin.addDirectoryItem(self._handle, url, li, is_folder)
        return len(items)

    def _search_in_portal_collect(self, p: dict, query: str) -> list:
        ptype  = p.get('type', 'm3u')
        items  = []

        if ptype == 'stb':
            stb = self._stb(p)
            if stb:
                from iptv import Channel
                from player import channel_list_item
                for s in stb.search_live(query)[:50]:
                    ch = Channel(name=s.get('name', ''), url=s.get('cmd', ''),
                                 logo=s.get('logo', ''), group='Live')
                    items.append((
                        self.url(action='play_stb_live', pid=p['id'],
                                 cmd=s.get('cmd', ''), name=ch.name, logo=ch.logo),
                        channel_list_item(ch), False))
                for v in stb.search_vod(query)[:50]:
                    li = xbmcgui.ListItem(v.get('name', ''))
                    li.setInfo('video', {'title': v.get('name', ''), 'mediatype': 'movie'})
                    li.setProperty('IsPlayable', 'true')
                    items.append((
                        self.url(action='play_stb_vod', pid=p['id'],
                                 cmd=v.get('cmd', ''), name=v.get('name', '')),
                        li, False))

        elif ptype == 'xtream':
            xc = self._xc(p)
            if xc:
                from iptv import Channel
                from player import channel_list_item, vod_list_item
                for s in xc.search_live(query)[:50]:
                    ch = Channel(name=s.get('name', ''),
                                 url=xc.live_stream_url(s['stream_id']),
                                 logo=s.get('stream_icon', ''), group='Live')
                    items.append((
                        self.url(action='play_live', url=ch.url,
                                 name=ch.name, logo=ch.logo),
                        channel_list_item(ch), False))
                for v in xc.search_vod(query)[:50]:
                    li = vod_list_item(v)
                    items.append((
                        self.url(action='play_vod', pid=p['id'],
                                 stream_id=v.get('stream_id'),
                                 ext=v.get('container_extension', 'mkv'),
                                 title=v.get('name'), logo=v.get('stream_icon', '')),
                        li, False))
                for s in xc.search_series(query)[:50]:
                    li = xbmcgui.ListItem(s.get('name', ''))
                    li.setArt({'thumb': s.get('cover', ''), 'icon': s.get('cover', '')})
                    li.setInfo('video', {'title': s.get('name', ''),
                                         'mediatype': 'tvshow', 'plot': s.get('plot', '')})
                    items.append((
                        self.url(action='series_seasons', pid=p['id'],
                                 series_id=s.get('series_id')),
                        li, True))

        else:
            from iptv import load_m3u, split_m3u_sections
            all_ch   = load_m3u(p.get('m3u_url', ''), portal_id=p['id'])
            sections = split_m3u_sections(all_ch)
            q = query.lower()
            for section, mediatype in (
                ('live',   'video'),
                ('movies', 'movie'),
                ('series', 'episode'),
            ):
                for ch in sections.get(section, []):
                    if q in ch.name.lower() or q in (ch.group or '').lower():
                        li = xbmcgui.ListItem(ch.name)
                        li.setArt({'thumb': ch.logo, 'icon': ch.logo})
                        li.setInfo('video', {'title': ch.name, 'mediatype': mediatype})
                        li.setProperty('IsPlayable', 'true')
                        items.append((
                            self.url(action='play_live', url=ch.url,
                                     name=ch.name, logo=ch.logo),
                            li, False))
                        if len(items) >= 200:
                            return apply_lang_sort(items, name_fn=lambda x: x[1].getLabel(), group_fn=lambda x: '')
        return apply_lang_sort(items, name_fn=lambda x: x[1].getLabel(), group_fn=lambda x: '')

    def _epg_channel(self):
        p = self._portal()
        if not p:
            return
        tvg_id = self._params.get('tvg_id', '')
        name   = self._params.get('name', tvg_id)
        sid = self._params.get('sid','')
        if sid:
            # A freshly edited mapping must not depend on a stale stream alias
            # left by an earlier XMLTV import. Share TV/preview resolution.
            xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle,succeeded=False,cacheToDisc=False)
            from epg import load_cache
            from epg_sources import configuration
            from epg_views import resolve_guide
            from epg_preview import programme_lines
            info=resolve_guide(load_cache(p['id']),tvg_id,sid,
                client=self._xc(p) if p.get('type')=='xtream' else None,
                mappings=configuration(p['id'])['mappings'])
            xbmcgui.Dialog().textviewer('XCMate - '+name,'\n'.join(programme_lines(info)))
            return
        xbmcplugin.setContent(self._handle, 'videos')
        xbmcplugin.setPluginCategory(self._handle, f'EPG – {name}')
        mgr = self._epg_mgr(p)
        now  = time.time()
        back = setting_int('epg_hours_back', 3) * 3600
        ahead= setting_int('epg_hours_ahead', 12) * 3600
        prgs = mgr.get_range(tvg_id, now - back, now + ahead) if mgr else []
        import datetime as _dt
        for pr in prgs:
            dt_s  = _dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(pr.start).strftime('%H:%M')
            label = f'{dt_s}  {pr.title}'
            if pr.episode:
                label += f'  [{pr.episode}]'
            li = xbmcgui.ListItem(label)
            li.setInfo('video', {
                'title': pr.title, 'plot': pr.desc,
                'genre': pr.category, 'episode': pr.episode,
                'duration': max(0, pr.stop - pr.start),
            })
            if pr.stop < now:
                xbmcplugin.addDirectoryItem(
                    self._handle,
                    self.url(action='play_catchup', pid=p['id'],
                             start=int(pr.start), stop=int(pr.stop),
                             tvg_id=tvg_id, name=pr.title),
                    li, False)
            else:
                xbmcplugin.addDirectoryItem(self._handle, '', li, False)
        xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle)

    def _catchup_list(self):

        import datetime as _dt
        for pr in sorted(prgs, key=lambda x: x.start, reverse=True):

        xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle)


    def _play_live(self):
        from live_exit import _trace
        _trace('LIVE_RESOLVER')
        import urllib.parse
        url  = self._params.get('url', '')
        name = self._params.get('name', '')
        logo = self._params.get('logo', '')
        if url and '%25' in url:
            url = urllib.parse.unquote(url)
        if not url and self._params.get('sid'):
            # Widgets only store non-secret portal IDs and Xtream stream IDs.
            import portals as _portal_store
            p = _portal_store.get_by_id(self._params.get('pid',''))
            if p and p.get('type') == 'xtream':
                xc = self._xc(p)
                url = xc.live_stream_url(self._params['sid'])
        if not url:
            error('play_live: no URL in params')
            notify('XCMate', 'Stream URL fehlt')
            xbmcplugin.setResolvedUrl(self._handle, False, xbmcgui.ListItem())
            return
        # The service displays a transparent on-video TV remote panel. Never
        # put the stream URL or Xtream credentials in the session marker.
        session=None
        import portals as _portals
        from live_recovery import recover_from_player_path
        from xtream import XtreamClient
        active=_portals.get_active()
        requested_pid=self._params.get('pid')
        if requested_pid:
            active=[p for p in active if str(p.get('id'))==str(requested_pid)]
        match=recover_from_player_path(url,active,XtreamClient)
        if match:
            from live_overlay import announce
            session=announce(match[0],match[1],name)
        else:
            from live_diagnostics import record
            record('session','SOURCE_NOT_VERIFIED',marker=False)
        from play_intent import before_play
        if not before_play(session):
            xbmcplugin.setResolvedUrl(self._handle, False, xbmcgui.ListItem())
            return
        from player import play_stream
        play_stream(self._handle, url, title=name, logo=logo,live_session=session)

                      .replace('{utc}', str(start))

                      .replace('{duration}', str(max(1, (stop - start) // 60))))
            play_catchup(self._handle, cu, start, stop, name)

    def _load_channels(self, p: dict, force: bool = False):
        ptype = p.get('type', 'm3u')
        if ptype == 'stb':
            from stalker import client_for_portal
            from iptv import Channel
            stb = client_for_portal(p)
            if not stb or not stb.authenticate():
                return []
            cats = {str(c['id']): c.get('title', '')
                    for c in stb.get_live_categories(force=force)}
            return [
                Channel(
                    name    = s.get('name', ''),
                    url     = s.get('cmd', ''),
                    logo    = s.get('logo', ''),
                    group   = cats.get(str(s.get('genre_id',
                                               s.get('tv_genre_id', ''))),
                                       'Uncategorised'),
                    tvg_id  = s.get('epg_channel_id') or str(s.get('id', '')),
                    tvg_name= s.get('name', ''),
                )
                for s in stb.get_live_channels(force=force)
            ]
        elif ptype == 'xtream':
            from xtream import XtreamClient
            from iptv import Channel
            xc   = XtreamClient(p['xc_host'], p['xc_user'], p['xc_pass'])
            # Never block back navigation with server requests. Kodi service
            # preloads these two indexes independently of the interface.
            cats_raw = (xc.get_live_categories(force_refresh=True) if force else
                        xc.get_cached_catalog('get_live_categories'))
            channels_raw = (xc.get_live_streams(force_refresh=True) if force else
                            xc.get_cached_catalog('get_live_streams'))
            if cats_raw is None or channels_raw is None:
                return []
            cats = {str(c['category_id']): c.get('category_name', '')
                    for c in cats_raw if isinstance(c, dict) and 'category_id' in c}
            return [
                Channel(
                    name    = s.get('name', ''),
                    url     = xc.live_stream_url(s.get('stream_id', ''), 'ts'),
                    logo    = s.get('stream_icon', ''),
                    group   = cats.get(str(s.get('category_id', '')), 'Uncategorised'),
                    extra   = {'category_id': str(s.get('category_id', '')),
                               'stream_id': str(s.get('stream_id', ''))},
                    tvg_id  = s.get('epg_channel_id', ''),
                    tvg_name= s.get('name', ''),
                )
                for s in channels_raw if isinstance(s, dict)
            ]
        else:
            from iptv import load_m3u
            url = p.get('m3u_url', '').strip()
            if not url:
                error(f'load_channels: portal "{p.get("name")}" has no m3u_url')
                return []
            return load_m3u(url,
                            portal_id=p.get('id', ''),
                            force_refresh=force)

    def _add_dir(self, label, url, icon=None, is_folder=True, plot='', fanart=None):
        li = xbmcgui.ListItem(label)

        _icon = for_url(url,icon)

"""XCMate remote-control TV navigation, displayed over active Xtream live TV.

First OK: compact programme info. Second OK/Down: player controls.
Left opens indexed channels; Left again opens groups. Back returns one level.
Up/Down zap only in full-screen mode. Stop releases playback and dialog.

Kodi handles native list movement before Python callbacks. Bridge commands move
the list explicitly; native events must not move it a second time. No network
requests are made in input callbacks.
"""
import json
import math
import os
import time
import uuid

import xbmc
import xbmcgui

from utils import info, warn


def trace(stage, code, **fields):
    try:
        from live_diagnostics import record
        record(stage,code,**fields)
    except Exception:
        pass

SESSION_KEY = 'XtreamMate.LiveSession'
ACTION_LEFT = 1
ACTION_RIGHT = 2
ACTION_UP = 3
ACTION_DOWN = 4
ACTION_PAGE_UP = 5
ACTION_PAGE_DOWN = 6
ACTION_SELECT = 7
ACTION_PREVIOUS_MENU = 10
ACTION_STOP = 13
ACTION_PAUSE = 12
ACTION_NAV_BACK = 92
ACTION_CONTEXT_MENU = 117
ACTION_PARENT_DIR = 9
BACK_ACTIONS = (ACTION_PREVIOUS_MENU, ACTION_NAV_BACK, ACTION_PARENT_DIR)
CHANNEL_PAGE_SIZE = 100


def announce(portal_id, stream_id, channel_name=''):
    """Set a small, short-lived playback marker; never store provider passwords."""
    from live_exit import new_selection
    new_selection()
    value = {'pid': str(portal_id), 'sid': str(stream_id),
             'name': str(channel_name)[:160], 'at': time.time(),
             'nonce': uuid.uuid4().hex}
    try:value['origin_window48']=int(xbmcgui.getCurrentWindowId())
    except (AttributeError,RuntimeError,ValueError):pass
    xbmcgui.Window(10000).setProperty(SESSION_KEY, json.dumps(value))
    trace('session','ANNOUNCED',marker=True)
    from epg_handoff63 import note as epg63_note
    epg63_note('OK_CLICK',portal_id,stream_id)
    return value


def session_from_property(raw, now=None):
    try:
        obj = json.loads(raw)
        if (not isinstance(obj, dict) or not obj.get('pid') or not obj.get('sid')
                or not obj.get('nonce')):
            if raw: trace('session','MARKER_INVALID',marker=True)
            return None
        at=float(obj.get('at',0))
        if not math.isfinite(at):
            trace('session','MARKER_INVALID',marker=True)
            return None
        if abs((time.time() if now is None else now) - at) > 86400:
            trace('session','MARKER_EXPIRED',marker=True)
            return None
        return obj
    except (TypeError, ValueError, KeyError):
        if raw: trace('session','MARKER_INVALID',marker=True)
        return None


def category_rows(categories, enabled):
    """Normal navigation contains active groups only; management keeps all."""
    selected=None if enabled is None else set(map(str,enabled))
    rows=[(str(c['category_id']),str(c.get('category_name') or c['category_id']),True)
          for c in categories if c.get('category_id') not in (None,'') and (selected is None or str(c['category_id']) in selected)]
    return [('*','Alle aktivierten Gruppen',True)]+rows if rows else [
        ('','Keine aktiven Gruppen – Menü: Gruppen verwalten',False)]


def channels_for_category(channels, category_id, enabled):
    active = None if enabled is None else {str(x) for x in enabled}
    return [ch for ch in channels
            if (active is None or str(ch.extra.get('category_id', '')) in active)
            and (category_id == '*' or str(ch.extra.get('category_id', '')) == category_id)]


def adjacent_channel(channels, category_id, enabled, current_sid, step):
    """Next/previous channel in provider order; wrap at group boundaries.

    Categories are identified by provider IDs, never translated display names.
    Disabled categories are excluded. Unknown station: select first/last.
    """
    choices = channels_for_category(channels, category_id, enabled)
    if not choices:
        return None
    current = str(current_sid)
    idx = next((i for i, channel in enumerate(choices)
                if str(channel.extra.get('stream_id', '')) == current), None)
    if idx is None:
        return choices[0 if step > 0 else -1]
    return choices[(idx + (1 if step > 0 else -1)) % len(choices)]


class LiveNavigator(xbmcgui.WindowDialog):
    """Nonblocking WindowDialog; service.py owns and closes its lifecycle."""

    def __init__(self, portal, initial_sid='', client=None):
        super().__init__()
        from xtream import XtreamClient
        from iptv import Channel
        from group_selection import load
        from tv_data import CatalogIndex, GuideSnapshot
        from types import SimpleNamespace
        self._stream_details=__import__('stream_details').Details()
        self._theme=__import__('theme_render').snapshot()
        self.portal = portal
        self._left_counts = dict(left_received=0,left_channels=0,left_groups=0)
        from remote_profiles import load as load_bindings, DEFAULT
        try:
            self._bindings = load_bindings()
        except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
            self._bindings = dict(DEFAULT)
            trace('input','PROFILE_FALLBACK')
        self.xc = client if client is not None else XtreamClient(portal['xc_host'], portal['xc_user'], portal['xc_pass'])
        self.sid = str(initial_sid)
        self._recent_sid = ''
        self._tune_deadline = 0
        self._previous_session = None
        self._window_nonce = uuid.uuid4().hex
        self.groups = []
        self.enabled = load(portal['id'])
        self.channels = []
        self.index = CatalogIndex(())
        self._identity_client = SimpleNamespace(live_stream_url=self.xc.live_stream_url,
            is_cached_live_id=lambda sid: sid in self.index.by_sid)
        self._catalog_ready = False
        from ui_latency39 import begin,mark
        begin(self);mark(self,'CATALOG_SCHEDULED')
        # Cache-only, no network. The background service warms missing data;
        # list presentation is fast even when the provider stalls.
        self._load_catalog_from_disk()
        # 0.1.25 starts with the video unobscured; first OK is information only.
        self.mode = 'hidden'
        self._intro_deadline = None
        self._focus_main = 0
        self._focus_extra = 0
        selected_stream = next((c for c in self.channels
                                if str(c.extra.get('stream_id')) == self.sid), None)
        # Normally zap within the playing station's own category. Selecting
        # "all enabled" explicitly allows zapping across all active groups.
        self.category_id = (str(selected_stream.extra.get('category_id'))
                            if selected_stream else __import__('tv_focus').target(portal,self.index,self.enabled)[0])
        self._scroll_to_current = True
        self.visible_channels = []
        self._page_start = self._row_offset = 0
        self.rows = category_rows(self.groups, self.enabled)
        self._drawn = False
        self._closed = False
        self._epg_fetching = False
        self._highlight = {'channels': 0, 'groups': 0, 'guide': 0}
        self._list_key = None
        self._info_deadline = None
        self._guide_generation = -1
        self._last_tick = 0
        try:
            from utils import setting_int
            self._info_timeout = min(30,max(3,setting_int('tv_infobar_seconds',8)))
        except Exception: self._info_timeout = 8
        self._guide = GuideSnapshot(portal,self.xc,initial_sid=self.sid)
        self._guide.request([selected_stream] if selected_stream else [])
        self._guide.start()
        from live_timing import nav_ready
        nav_ready(self)

    def _load_catalog_from_disk(self):
        from iptv import Channel
        started=time.perf_counter()
        from live_catalog import read,prepare
        prepared47=None
        if self.portal.get('type')=='xtream':
            future=getattr(self,'_catalog_future39',None)
            if future is None:future=self._catalog_future39=prepare(self.portal,self.xc)
            if not future.done():
                if getattr(self,'_catalog_partial46',False):return False
                first46=getattr(future,'first46',None)
                if first46 is None:return False
                categories,streams=first46;self._catalog_partial46=True
                prepared47=getattr(future,'first_model47',None)
            else:
                self._catalog_partial46=False
                try:categories,streams=future.result()
                except Exception:categories,streams=None,None
                prepared47=getattr(future,'model47',None)
            if categories is None or streams is None:self._catalog_future39=None
        else:categories,streams = read(self.portal,self.xc)
        loaded=time.perf_counter()
        if categories is None or streams is None:
            return False
        if prepared47 is not None:
            self.groups,self.channels=prepared47['groups'],prepared47['channels']
            self.enabled,self.index=prepared47['enabled'],prepared47['index']
            self._catalog_ready=True
            from flow46 import mark as mark_flow47
            if self.channels:mark_flow47('GROUPS_READY',pid=self.portal['id'],sid=self.sid)
            trace('catalog_performance','MODEL_REUSED47',cache_ms=(loaded-started)*1000,index_ms=0,channels=len(self.channels))
            from ui_latency39 import mark
            mark(self,'CATALOG_READY')
            return True
        groups = [c for c in categories if isinstance(c, dict)]
        names = {str(c.get('category_id')): c.get('category_name', '')
                 for c in groups}
        channels = []
        for stream in streams:
            if not isinstance(stream, dict) or not stream.get('stream_id'):
                continue
            cid = str(stream.get('category_id', ''))
            channels.append(Channel(
                name=stream.get('name', ''),
                url=self.xc.live_stream_url(stream['stream_id'], 'ts'),
                logo=stream.get('stream_icon', ''),
                group=str(names.get(cid, cid)),
                tvg_id=str(stream.get('epg_channel_id') or ''),
                extra={'category_id': cid,
                       'stream_id': str(stream['stream_id'])}))
        self.groups, self.channels = groups, channels
        from group_selection import enabled_ids
        self.enabled=enabled_ids(self.portal['id'],'live',groups)
        from tv_data import CatalogIndex
        self.index = CatalogIndex(channels)
        self.index.selection('*',self.enabled)
        trace('catalog_performance','CATALOG_READY',cache_ms=(loaded-started)*1000,
              index_ms=(time.perf_counter()-loaded)*1000,channels=len(channels))
        self._catalog_ready = True
        from flow46 import mark as mark_flow46
        if channels:mark_flow46('GROUPS_READY',pid=self.portal['id'],sid=self.sid)
        from ui_latency39 import mark
        mark(self,'CATALOG_READY')
        return True

    def refresh_from_cache(self):
        """Service polls only until initial background warming has completed."""
        if self._catalog_ready and not getattr(self,'_catalog_partial46',False) or not self._load_catalog_from_disk():
            self.tick()
            return False
        self.rows = category_rows(self.groups, self.enabled)
        selected_stream = next((c for c in self.channels
                                if str(c.extra.get('stream_id')) == self.sid), None)
        if selected_stream:
            self.category_id = str(selected_stream.extra.get('category_id'))
        if self.mode in ('channels', 'groups'):
            self._render()
        return True

    def show(self):
        """Plain Omega WindowDialog does not dispatch Python onInit()."""
        if self._closed:
            return
        self._startup_stage = 'BUILD_CONTROLS'
        try:
            if not self._drawn:
                from ui_latency39 import mark
                mark(self,'BUILD_BEGIN')
                self._build_controls()
                mark(self,'BUILD_END')
                xbmcgui.Window(10000).setProperty('XtreamMate.NativeActionCount','0')
                trace('input','WAITING_FOR_ACTION',count=0,
                      learned_left_action=self._bindings.get('left',ACTION_LEFT))
            try: self.setProperty('XtreamMate.NavigatorIdentity',self._window_nonce)
            except Exception: pass
            trace('dialog','SHOW_REQUESTED',channels=len(self.channels),catalog=self._catalog_ready)
            self._startup_stage = 'WINDOW_SHOW'
            from ui_latency39 import mark
            mark(self,'SHOW_BEGIN')
            super().show()
            mark(self,'SHOW_RETURN')
            self._startup_stage = 'RENDER'
            self._render()
            from live_timing import visible
            visible(self)
            self._startup_stage = 'FOCUS'
            self.observe_focus()
        except Exception as exc:
            trace('dialog','SHOW_FAILED',failure_stage=self._startup_stage,
                  exception_class=type(exc).__name__)
            self.close()
            raise

    def suspend_for_guide(self):
        """Service-only close: preserve the immutable running live session."""
        if self._closed:return
        self._clear_surface40()
        self._closed=True
        if hasattr(self,'_guide'):self._guide.close()
        self._intro_deadline=None
        xbmcgui.Window(10000).clearProperty('XtreamMate.RemoteCommand')
        super().close()

    def observe_focus(self):
        focus_id=dialog_id=-1
        try: focus_id=self.getFocusId()
        except Exception: pass
        try: dialog_id=xbmcgui.getCurrentWindowDialogId()
        except Exception: pass
        controls=([self.control,self.capture,*self.main_buttons,*self.extra_buttons]
                  if self._drawn else [])
        trace('focus','OBSERVED',focus_id=focus_id,dialog_id=dialog_id,
              focused=any(c.getId()==focus_id for c in controls))
        if dialog_id>0:
            try:
                active=xbmcgui.Window(dialog_id).getProperty('XtreamMate.NavigatorIdentity')==self._window_nonce
                trace('focus','ACTIVE_DIALOG' if active else 'OTHER_DIALOG',
                      focus_id=focus_id,dialog_id=dialog_id,focused=active)
            except Exception: pass

    def _clear_surface40(self):
        if not self._drawn:return
        self._nav_rail.hide();self._mini.visible(False)
        self._micro44.hide();self._row_paint44={}
        for control in (self.heading,self.sub,self.footer,self.osd_title,*self._info_controls):
            if hasattr(control,'setLabel'):control.setLabel('')
            control.setVisible(False)
        for row in self._row_controls:
            for control in row:
                if hasattr(control,'setLabel'):control.setLabel('')
                control.setVisible(False)
        for control in (self.bg,self.control,self.osd_bg,*self.main_buttons,*self.extra_buttons,*[image for _,image in self._button_icons]):control.setVisible(False)

    def close(self):
        if self._closed:
            return
        self._clear_surface40()
        self._closed = True
        if hasattr(self, '_guide'): self._guide.close()
        self._intro_deadline = None
        super().close()
        marker = xbmcgui.Window(10000)
        marker.clearProperty('XtreamMate.RemoteCommand')
        session = session_from_property(marker.getProperty(SESSION_KEY))
        if session and (session['pid'], session['sid']) == (str(self.portal['id']), self.sid) and (not getattr(self,'_exit_nonce','') or session['nonce']==self._exit_nonce):
            marker.clearProperty(SESSION_KEY)
        marker.setProperty('XtreamMate.OverlayStatus', 'geschlossen')
        trace('dialog','CLOSED',video=xbmc.Player().isPlayingVideo())
        try:
            from live_diagnostics import checkpoint
            checkpoint(defer=True)
        except Exception: pass

    def owns_playback(self):
        """Release input immediately if playback belongs to another add-on."""
        try:
            player = xbmc.Player()
            if not player.isPlayingVideo():
                return False
            from live_recovery import playback_match
            session=session_from_property(xbmcgui.Window(10000).getProperty(SESSION_KEY))
            match,reason = playback_match(player,[self.portal],lambda *args:self._identity_client,session)
            if not match and self._previous_session and time.monotonic()<self._tune_deadline:
                match,reason=playback_match(player,[self.portal],lambda *args:self._identity_client,self._previous_session)
                if match: reason='PREVIOUS_'+reason
            trace('ownership',reason,video=True,marker=bool(session),catalog=self._catalog_ready)
            if not match or match[0] != str(self.portal['id']):
                return False
            # Player.play is asynchronous; the old verified live URL may remain
            # visible briefly while Kodi resolves the newly selected channel.
            return (match[1] == self.sid or
                    (match[1] == self._recent_sid and
                     time.monotonic() < self._tune_deadline))
        except Exception:
            trace('ownership','CHECK_FAILED')
            return False

    def _accept_input(self):
        from live_guide_navigation import reconcile_input
        reconcile_input(self)
        from ui_latency39 import mark
        mark(self,'OWNER_BEGIN')
        if self._closed or getattr(self,'_exiting',False) or getattr(self,'_guide_handoff',False):
            return False
        if not self.owns_playback():
            self.close()
            return False
        from playback_exit import identity
        try:self._owned_token=identity(xbmc.Player())
        except (AttributeError,RuntimeError):self._owned_token=None
        mark(self,'OWNER_READY')
        return True

    def _request_exit(self,reason='USER_BACK'):
        from live_exit import request,_trace
        try:accepted=request(self,reason=reason)
        except (AttributeError,RuntimeError):accepted=False
        if not accepted:_trace('STOP_REJECTED')
        return accepted

    def _build_controls(self):

                xbmcgui.ControlLabel(106,y+1,sidebar-128,27,'','font13','0xFFF0F2F5'),
                xbmcgui.ControlLabel(106,y+28,sidebar-128,25,'','font12','0xFFB6BCC6')))
        from infobar45 import InfoBar

        # Stable action indices; visual tape-deck order is defined in _render.
        main = [('Pause','pause'),('-10 s','back'),('+30 s','forward'),('Stop','stop'),('Weitere','more'),('Live-Ende','live')]
        extra = [('Ton','audio'),('Bild','video'),('Untertitel','subtitle'),('EPG','epg'),('Einstellungen','settings'),('Gruppen','tv'),('Info','info')]
        for entries,buttons,y in ((main,self.main_buttons,height-262),(extra,self.extra_buttons,height-144)):
            space = (width-104)//len(entries)

                self._button_icons.append((buttons[-1],xbmcgui.ControlImage(52+i*space+(space-48)//2 if buttons is self.main_buttons else 60+i*space,y+6,48 if buttons is self.main_buttons else 26,48 if buttons is self.main_buttons else 26,__import__('player_controls').texture(icon))))
        all_controls = [self.bg,self.heading,self.sub,self.control,self.footer,self.capture,
