    def _render_rows(self):
        selected = max(0,self.control.getSelectedPosition())
        first = selected//8*8
        footer_text='OK: auswählen    Links: Gruppen    Zurück: TV'
        wanted = []
        playing = self.index.by_sid.get(self.sid)
        if playing: wanted.append(playing)
        for slot,(background,_,_,_) in enumerate(self._row_controls):
            if first+slot!=selected:self._row_value44(background,'setVisible',False)
        for row,(background,logo,title,detail) in enumerate(self._row_controls):
            i = first+row
            available = i<len(self._labels)
            if not available:
                for c in (background,logo,title,detail):self._row_value44(c,'setVisible',False)
                self._row_value44(title,'setLabel','');self._row_value44(detail,'setLabel','');continue
            label,subtitle,channel = self._labels[i],'',None
            if self.mode == 'channels':
                absolute = self._page_start+i-self._row_offset
                if self._row_offset<=i<self._row_offset+min(CHANNEL_PAGE_SIZE,len(self.visible_channels)-self._page_start):
                    channel = self.visible_channels[absolute]
                    wanted.append(channel)
                    sid = str(channel.extra.get('stream_id',''))
                    before=time.perf_counter()
                    info = self._guide.get(sid)
                    self._snapshot_ms=getattr(self,'_snapshot_ms',0)+(time.perf_counter()-before)*1000
                    label = ('LIVE  ' if sid==self.sid else '')+channel.name
                    subtitle = '{}-{}  {}'.format(info['now_time'],info['now_end_time'],info['now'][:40]) if info['now'] else 'Keine aktuellen EPG-Daten'
                    if i==selected and info['next']:
                        footer_text='Danach {}: {}'.format(info['next_time'],info['next'])
            elif self.mode == 'guide' and i<len(self._programme_events):
                subtitle = self._programme_events[i].get('description','')[:100]
            self._row_value44(title,'setLabel',label)
            self._row_value44(detail,'setLabel',subtitle)
            self._row_value44(logo,'setImage',self._local_logo(channel))
            for c in (logo,title,detail):self._row_value44(c,'setVisible',True)
            self._row_value44(background,'setVisible',i==selected)
        if self.mode == 'guide':
            channel = self.index.by_sid.get(self._guide_sid)
            if channel: wanted.append(channel)
        if self.mode=='channels':
            self._mini.render()
            selected=self.index.by_sid.get(self._mini.sid)
            if selected is not None and selected not in wanted:wanted.append(selected)
            request_programme=getattr(self._guide,'request_programme',None)
            if request_programme:request_programme(self._mini.sid)
        self._row_value44(self.footer,'setLabel',footer_text)
        self._guide.request(wanted)

    def _render(self, focus=True):
        if not self._drawn: return
        begin = time.perf_counter()
        self._snapshot_ms=0
        index_ms=0
        listing = self.mode in ('groups','channels','guide')
        osd = self.mode in ('controls','extras')
        for c in (self.bg,self.heading,self.sub,self.control,self.footer): c.setVisible(listing)
        if not listing:
            for c in (self.heading,self.sub):c.setLabel('')
            self._row_value44(self.footer,'setLabel','')
            for _,_,title,detail in self._row_controls:self._row_value44(title,'setLabel','');self._row_value44(detail,'setLabel','')
        if not osd:self.osd_title.setLabel('')
        if not listing:
            for row in self._row_controls:
                for c in row:self._row_value44(c,'setVisible',False)
        for c in self._info_controls:c.setVisible(self.mode=='info' and c not in (self.info_hint,self.info_duration))
        if self.mode!='info':self._micro44.hide()
        for c in (self.osd_bg,self.osd_title): c.setVisible(osd)
        seek = self._can_seek() if osd else False
        transport = [1,0,2,5,3,4]
        self._main_indices = transport if seek else [0,3,4]
        if not xbmc.getCondVisibility('Player.PauseEnabled'):self._main_indices=[i for i in self._main_indices if i!=0]
        for i,c in enumerate(self.main_buttons):
            c.setVisible(osd)
            c.setEnabled(i in self._main_indices)
        for slot,i in enumerate(transport):
            space=(self._width-104)//len(transport)
            self.main_buttons[i].setPosition(52+slot*space,self._height-262)
            self.main_buttons[i].setWidth(space-8)
            self._button_icons[i][1].setPosition(52+slot*space+(space-48)//2,self._height-256)
        for c in self.extra_buttons:c.setVisible(osd)
        for button,image in self._button_icons:
            image.setVisible(osd)
        self._mini.visible(self.mode=='channels')
        if self.mode=='groups':self._nav_rail.show(False,focus=False)
        elif self.mode not in ('nav_icons','nav_expanded'):self._nav_rail.hide()
        if self.mode in ('nav_icons','nav_expanded'):
            self._nav_rail.show(self.mode=='nav_expanded',focus=focus)
            return
        # Both mini columns share the existing panel; groups retain old geometry.
        left=int(self._width*.32) if self.mode=='channels' else self._sidebar
        self.bg.setWidth(int(self._width*.76) if self.mode=='channels' else self._sidebar)
        shift=92 if self.mode=='groups' else 0
        self.bg.setPosition(24+shift,24);self.heading.setPosition(48+shift,38)
        self.sub.setPosition(48+shift,78);self.control.setPosition(44+shift,116)
        self.footer.setPosition(48+shift,self._height-73)
        self.control.setWidth(left-40)
        for row,(background,logo,title,detail) in enumerate(self._row_controls):
            y=116+row*((self._height-210)//8)
            self._row_value44(background,'setPosition',44+shift,y);self._row_value44(logo,'setPosition',52+shift,y+7)
            self._row_value44(title,'setPosition',106+shift,y+1);self._row_value44(detail,'setPosition',106+shift,y+28)
            self._row_value44(background,'setWidth',left-40);self._row_value44(title,'setWidth',left-128);self._row_value44(detail,'setWidth',left-128)
        target = self.capture
        if self.mode=='info': self._render_info()
        elif osd:
            self._render_transport()
            if self._focus_main not in self._main_indices:
                previous=self.main_buttons[self._focus_main]
                self._focus_main=self._main_indices[0]
                if self.mode=='controls' and not focus:
                    try:
                        dialog=xbmcgui.Window(xbmcgui.getCurrentWindowDialogId())
                        # Repair a newly disabled seek focus only while this
                        # dialog is topmost; never steal Audio/Video's focus.
                        focus=(self.getFocusId()==previous.getId() and
                               dialog.getProperty('XtreamMate.NavigatorIdentity')==self._window_nonce)
                    except (AttributeError,RuntimeError): pass
            title = ('Player - Runter: Einstellungen' if seek else
                     'Player - Kein Spulen/Live-Ende verfügbar - Runter: Einstellungen')
            self.osd_title.setLabel('XCMate - '+(title if self.mode=='controls' else 'Einstellungen - Hoch: Player'))
            target = self.main_buttons[self._focus_main] if self.mode=='controls' else self.extra_buttons[self._focus_extra]
        elif listing:
            index_begin=time.perf_counter()
            labels = self._list_content()
            index_ms=(time.perf_counter()-index_begin)*1000
            key = (self.mode,self.category_id,self._page_start,tuple(labels))
            if key != self._list_key:
                self.control.reset()
                self.control.addItems(labels)
                self._labels,self._list_key = labels,key
                pos = self._highlight[self.mode]
                if self.mode=='channels': pos = pos-self._page_start+self._row_offset
                self.control.selectItem(min(max(pos,0),len(labels)-1))
            self.heading.setLabel('XCMate - '+{'channels':'LIVE-TV','groups':'SENDERGRUPPEN','guide':'PROGRAMM'}[self.mode])
            if self.mode=='channels':
                self.sub.setLabel('{} Sender'.format(len(self.visible_channels)))
            elif self.mode=='guide':
                ch=self.index.by_sid.get(self._guide_sid)
                self.sub.setLabel(ch.name if ch else 'Programmübersicht')
            else: self.sub.setLabel('OK: öffnen    Menü: Gruppen verwalten')
            self._render_rows()
            target = self._mini.list if self.mode=='channels' and self._mini.focused else self.control
        render_end = time.perf_counter()
        if focus: self.setFocus(target)
        from ui_latency39 import mark,finish
        mark(self,'GUI_APPLIED');finish(self)
        trace('performance',self.mode.upper(),index_ms=index_ms,snapshot_ms=self._snapshot_ms,
              render_ms=max(0,(render_end-begin)*1000-index_ms-self._snapshot_ms),focus_ms=(time.perf_counter()-render_end)*1000,
              items=len(getattr(self,'_labels',[])) if listing else 0)

    def tick(self):
        if self._closed or not self._drawn: return
        if getattr(self,'_programme_request46',None):
            from programme_window46 import open_pending
            open_pending(self)
        from playback_exit import identity
        from osd_ownership import recover
        player=xbmc.Player();token=identity(player)
        if token and token[0]=='live' and token[1]['pid']==str(self.portal['id']) and token[1]['sid']==self.sid:
            if recover(player,token):
                self._standard_recovery=True
                self._recovery_target40=self.mode if self.mode in ('controls','extras') else 'info'
                return
            if getattr(self,'_standard_recovery',False):
                dialog=xbmcgui.getCurrentWindowDialogId()
                if dialog in (0,9999):
                    self._standard_recovery=False;self.mode=getattr(self,'_recovery_target40','info')
                    self._info_deadline=time.monotonic()+self._info_timeout if self.mode=='info' else None
                    self.show()
        now=time.monotonic()
        if self.mode=='info' and self._info_deadline is not None and now>=self._info_deadline:
            self._switch('hidden')
            return
        if now-self._last_tick<1: return
        self._last_tick=now
        if self.mode=='info': self._render_info()
        elif self.mode in ('controls','extras'):
            self._render(focus=False)
        elif self.mode in ('channels','groups','guide') and self._guide.generation!=self._guide_generation:
            self._guide_generation=self._guide.generation
            self._render(focus=False)

    def expire_intro(self):
        """Service timer: refresh local info and expire only the INFO_BAR."""
        self.tick()

    def _position(self, step):
        if self.mode=='channels':
            self._move_channels(step)
            return
        count = self.control.size()
        if count > 0:
            i = min(max(self.control.getSelectedPosition() + step, 0), count - 1)
            self.control.selectItem(i)
            self._remember_position()
            self._render_rows()

    def _remember_position(self):
        i = self.control.getSelectedPosition()
        if self.mode == 'channels':
            i = self._page_start + i - self._row_offset
            # Page links are not channels and must never become tune targets.
            if not self._page_start <= i < min(self._page_start+CHANNEL_PAGE_SIZE,
                                                len(self.visible_channels)):
                return
        self._highlight[self.mode] = i

    def _move_channels(self,step):
        """Absolute position; Kodi's native list movement is never applied twice."""
        if not self.visible_channels: return False
        previous=self._highlight['channels']
        target=min(max(previous+step,0),len(self.visible_channels)-1)
        self._highlight['channels']=target
        self._scroll_to_current=False
        if not self._page_start<=target<self._page_start+CHANNEL_PAGE_SIZE:
            self._render()
        else:
            self.control.selectItem(target-self._page_start)
            self._render_rows()
        return target!=previous

    def _page_channels(self, step):
        if len(self.visible_channels)<=CHANNEL_PAGE_SIZE: return False
        return self._move_channels(step*CHANNEL_PAGE_SIZE)

    def _focus_playing_channel(self):
        from tv_focus import target
        from playback_exit import identity
        try:owned=identity(xbmc.Player())
        except (AttributeError,RuntimeError):owned=None
        sid=owned[1]['sid'] if owned and owned[0]=='live' and owned[1]['pid']==str(self.portal['id']) else ''
        self.category_id,position,found=target(self.portal,self.index,self.enabled,sid)
        self._highlight['channels']=position;self._scroll_to_current=False;self._list_key=None
        trace('focus','CURRENT_CHANNEL',count=position,focused=found)

    def _switch(self, mode):
        self.mode = mode
        self._info_deadline = time.monotonic()+self._info_timeout if mode=='info' else None
        self._render()
        from live_timing import visible
        visible(self)

    def _toggle(self):
        """Menu opens explicit checkbox management, never toggles a nav row."""
        if self.mode!='groups': return
        from group_selection import choose_groups,enabled_ids
        if not choose_groups(self.portal,'live',categories=self.groups,allow_refresh=False): return
        self.enabled=enabled_ids(self.portal['id'],'live',self.groups)
        self._catalog_ready=False
        from live_catalog import prepare
        self._catalog_future39=prepare(self.portal,self.xc,force=True)
        self._load_catalog_from_disk()
        if self.category_id!='*' and self.category_id not in self.enabled:
            self.category_id=__import__('tv_focus').target(self.portal,self.index,self.enabled)[0]
        self._highlight['groups']=0
        self._highlight['channels']=0
        self._scroll_to_current=False
        self._list_key=None
        self._render()

    def _select(self):
        if self.mode == 'groups':
            i = self.control.getSelectedPosition()
            if 0 <= i < len(self.rows):
                cid, _, active = self.rows[i]
                if not active: return
                self.category_id = cid
                self._scroll_to_current = False
                self._highlight['channels'] = 0
                self._switch('channels')
        elif self.mode == 'guide':
            i = self.control.getSelectedPosition()
            if 0<=i<len(self._programme_events):
                event=self._programme_events[i]
                from programme_window46 import request
                request(self,self.index.by_sid.get(self._guide_sid),event)
        elif self.mode == 'channels':
            row = self.control.getSelectedPosition()
            i = self._page_start + row - self._row_offset
            if 0 <= i < len(self.visible_channels):
                c = self.visible_channels[i]
                self._highlight[self.mode] = i
                self._tune(c)

    def _tune(self, channel):
        from exit_jobs import blocked
        if blocked():return
        from player import build_playable_item
        sid = str(channel.extra.get('stream_id', ''))
        if not sid:
            return
        if self.sid != sid:
            self._recent_sid = self.sid
            self._tune_deadline = time.monotonic() + 8
        self.sid = sid
        current = self.index.by_sid.get(sid)
        self._guide.request([current] if current else [])
        self._scroll_to_current = True
        self._previous_session=session_from_property(xbmcgui.Window(10000).getProperty(SESSION_KEY))
        session=announce(self.portal['id'], sid, channel.name)
        self._switch('hidden')
        item = build_playable_item(channel.url, title=channel.name, logo=channel.logo,live67=True)
        from live_recovery import tag_live_item
        trace('session','ITEM_TAGGED' if tag_live_item(item,session) else 'ITEM_TAG_UNAVAILABLE',marker=True)
        xbmc.Player().play(item.getPath(), item)

    def _zap(self, step):
        rows,positions = self.index.selection(self.category_id,self.enabled)
        pos = (positions[self.sid]+step)%len(rows) if self.sid in positions else (0 if step>0 else -1)
        channel = rows[pos] if rows else None
        if channel is None:
            xbmcgui.Dialog().notification('XCMate',
                'Keine aktiven Sender in dieser Gruppe.')
            return
        self._tune(channel)

    def _seek(self, seconds):
        if not self._can_seek(): return
        player = xbmc.Player()
        try:
            duration = float(player.getTotalTime())
            position = float(player.getTime())
            if not math.isfinite(position):
                raise ValueError('live stream without timeshift')
            player.seekTime(duration if seconds is None else min(max(position+seconds, 0), duration))
        except Exception:
            xbmcgui.Dialog().notification('XCMate',
                'Spulen ist bei diesem Live-Sender nicht verfügbar (kein Timeshift).')

    def _epg(self):
        self._guide_return = self.mode if self.mode != 'guide' else getattr(self,'_guide_return','extras')
        self._guide_sid = self.sid
        self._highlight['guide'] = 0
        self._switch('guide')

    def _execute(self, section, index):
        if section == 'controls':
            if index in (1,2,5) and not self._can_seek(): return
            if index == 4:
                self._switch('extras')
                return
            if index == 0:
                if not xbmc.getCondVisibility('Player.PauseEnabled') or not self.owns_playback():return
                xbmc.Player().pause()
            elif index == 1: self._seek(-10)
            elif index == 2: self._seek(30)
            elif index == 5: self._seek(None)
            elif index == 3:
                self._request_exit('USER_STOP')
                return
            self._render()
        else:
            if index == 3:
                from live_guide_navigation import request
                request(self)
                return
            if index == 5:
                self._switch('groups')
                return
            self._switch('hidden')
            if index in (0,1,2):
                window=('osdaudiosettings','osdvideosettings','osdsubtitlesettings')[index]
                xbmc.executebuiltin('ActivateWindow('+window+')')
            elif index==6:
                __import__('stream_details').present(self._stream_details.read(xbmc.Player(),getattr(self,'_owned_token',None)))
            elif index == 4:
                import xbmcaddon
                xbmcaddon.Addon().openSettings()

    def _recent(self):
        channel = self.index.by_sid.get(self._recent_sid)
        if channel is not None:
            self._tune(channel)
        else:
            xbmcgui.Dialog().notification('XCMate', 'Noch kein vorheriger Sender.')

    def _search_channels(self):
        """Only cached channel names; no portal access or network requests."""
        query = xbmcgui.Dialog().input('XCMate – Sender suchen')
        if not query:
            return
        choices = channels_for_category(self.channels, '*', self.enabled)
        result = next((ch for ch in choices if query.casefold() in ch.name.casefold()), None)
        if result is None:
            xbmcgui.Dialog().notification('XCMate', 'Kein passender Sender gefunden.')
            return
        self.category_id = str(result.extra.get('category_id') or '*')
        self._scroll_to_current = False
        self._highlight['channels'] = next((i for i,c in enumerate(
            channels_for_category(self.channels, self.category_id, self.enabled))
            if str(c.extra.get('stream_id')) == str(result.extra.get('stream_id'))), 0)
        self._switch('channels')

    def _input_trace(self, code, source, command='', before=None, **fields):
        try: focus_id=self.getFocusId()
        except (RuntimeError, AttributeError): focus_id=-1
        counts=getattr(self,'_left_counts',{})
        if code=='COMMAND_HANDLED' and source=='native' and fields.get('action_id')==ACTION_LEFT:
            counts['left_received']=counts.get('left_received',0)+1
            if before in ('hidden','info') and self.mode=='channels':
                counts['left_channels']=counts.get('left_channels',0)+1
            elif before=='channels' and self.mode=='groups':
                counts['left_groups']=counts.get('left_groups',0)+1
        trace('input',code,input_source=source,command=command,
              mode_before=before or self.mode,mode_after=self.mode,focus_id=focus_id,
              learned_left_action=getattr(self,'_bindings',{}).get('left',ACTION_LEFT),**counts,**fields)

    def handle_command(self, command, source='bridge', **fields):
        from live_timing import remote
        remote(self,command)
        before=self.mode
        try: fields['focus_before']=self.getFocusId()
        except (RuntimeError,AttributeError): pass
        if not self._accept_input():
            self._input_trace('COMMAND_REJECTED',source,command,before,**fields)
            return
        self._handle_command(command)
        self._input_trace('COMMAND_HANDLED',source,command,before,**fields)
        from ui_latency39 import mark,finish
        mark(self,'GUI_APPLIED');finish(self)

    def _handle_command(self, command):
        """XCMate-local TV commands; never open Kodi's own player OSD."""
        self._intro_deadline = None
        if self.mode=='nav_expanded' and command in ('right','back'):
            self._switch('groups');return
        if self.mode in ('nav_icons','nav_expanded'):
            if self._nav_rail.command(command):
                if self._nav_rail.active:self.mode='nav_expanded' if self._nav_rail.expanded else 'nav_icons'
                return
        if self.mode=='channels' and self._mini.command(command):return
        if self.mode=='info': self._info_deadline=time.monotonic()+self._info_timeout
        if command in ('left', 'long_left'):
            if self.mode in ('controls', 'extras'):
                if self.mode == 'controls':
                    self._focus_main = self._main_indices[(self._main_indices.index(self._focus_main)-1)%len(self._main_indices)]
                else:
                    self._focus_extra = (self._focus_extra - 1) % len(self.extra_buttons)
                self._render()
            elif self.mode == 'channels':
                self._switch('groups')
            elif self.mode == 'groups':
                self._switch('nav_expanded')
            else:
                if self.mode in ('hidden','info'):self._focus_playing_channel()
                self._switch('channels')
        elif command == 'right':
            if self.mode == 'hidden':
                self._recent()
            elif self.mode == 'groups':
                self._switch('channels')
            elif self.mode=='channels':
                self._mini.focus()
            elif self.mode=='guide':self._switch('hidden')
            elif self.mode in ('controls','extras'):
                if self.mode == 'controls':
                    self._focus_main = self._main_indices[(self._main_indices.index(self._focus_main)+1)%len(self._main_indices)]
                else:
                    self._focus_extra = (self._focus_extra + 1) % len(self.extra_buttons)
                self._render()
        elif command in ('more', 'long_ok', 'menu', 'long_menu'):
            if command == 'menu' and self.mode == 'groups':
                self._toggle()
            elif command == 'long_menu':
                self._epg()
            else:
                self._switch('extras')
        elif command in ('epg', 'guide'):
            self._epg()
        elif command in ('info', 'long_right'):
            self._switch('info')
        elif command in ('back',):
            if self.mode == 'hidden':
                self._request_exit()
            elif self.mode == 'channels':
                self._switch('hidden')
            elif self.mode == 'guide':
                self._switch(self._guide_return)
            elif self.mode == 'groups':
                self._switch('channels')
            elif self.mode == 'extras':
                self._switch('controls')
            elif self.mode == 'controls':
                self._switch('info')
            else:
                self._switch('hidden')
        elif command == 'long_back':
            self._request_exit()
        elif command == 'long_up':
            self._recent()
        elif command == 'long_down':
            self._search_channels()
        elif command == 'long_play_pause':
            self._seek(None)
        elif command == 'play_pause':
            if xbmc.getCondVisibility('Player.PauseEnabled') and self.owns_playback():xbmc.Player().pause()
        elif command in ('up', 'down'):
            if self.mode == 'hidden':
                self._zap(1 if command == 'up' else -1)
            elif self.mode=='info':
                if command=='down': self._switch('controls')
                else: self._switch('hidden')
            elif self.mode in ('channels', 'groups', 'guide'):
                self._position(-1 if command == 'up' else 1)
            elif self.mode in ('controls','extras'):
                if self.mode=='controls': self._switch('info' if command=='up' else 'extras')
                elif command=='up': self._switch('controls')
        elif command == 'ok':
            if self.mode == 'hidden':
                self._switch('info')
            elif self.mode=='info':
                self._focus_main=0
                self._switch('controls')
            elif self.mode == 'controls':
                self._execute('controls', self._focus_main)
            elif self.mode == 'extras':
                self._execute('extras', self._focus_extra)
            else:
                self._select()

    def onAction(self, action):
        from ui_latency39 import begin
        begin(self,action.getId())
        """Native Kodi Android actions take priority while our dialog owns focus.

        Log numeric action/buttoncode only; never include stream URLs.
        The keymap bridge is a fallback, not the sole remote input path.
        """
        key = int(action.getId())
        try:
            raw = int(action.getButtonCode())
        except Exception:
            raw = 0
        if key==ACTION_STOP and not self._closed and not getattr(self,'_exiting',False):
            self._request_exit('USER_STOP');return
        if key in BACK_ACTIONS and getattr(self,'_guide_handoff',False):
            from live_guide_navigation import cancel_pending
            if cancel_pending(self):return
        was_closed=getattr(self,'_closed',False)
        if not self._accept_input():
            trace('input','ACTION_IGNORED_CLOSED' if was_closed else 'ACTION_REJECTED',
                  action_id=key,button_code=raw)
            return
        self._intro_deadline = None
        marker = xbmcgui.Window(10000)
        marker.setProperty('XtreamMate.LastRemoteKey', '{} / {} (native)'.format(key, raw))
        marker.setProperty('XtreamMate.AutoPopupStatus',
                           'natives Action-Event empfangen')
        try:
            count = int(marker.getProperty('XtreamMate.NativeActionCount') or '0')
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            count = 0
        marker.setProperty('XtreamMate.NativeActionCount', str(count+1))
        self._input_trace('NATIVE_ACTION','native',action_id=key,button_code=raw,count=count+1)
        # Back and Context are *not* Kodi player OSD commands in XCMate.
        # Must override learned Back->left and default Menu->epg from old profiles.
        if key in BACK_ACTIONS:
            mapped = 'back'
        elif key == ACTION_CONTEXT_MENU:
            mapped = 'menu'
        elif key == ACTION_PAUSE:
            mapped = 'play_pause'
        elif key == ACTION_RIGHT:
            mapped = 'right'
        elif key == ACTION_LEFT:
            mapped = 'left'
        elif key in (ACTION_UP,ACTION_DOWN) and self.mode=='channels' and self._mini.focused:
            self._mini.command('up' if key==ACTION_UP else 'down',native=True);return
        elif key in (ACTION_UP, ACTION_DOWN, ACTION_PAGE_UP, ACTION_PAGE_DOWN) and self.mode in ('channels', 'guide', 'groups'):
            # CGUIControlList already applied this action before onAction.
            if key in (ACTION_UP,ACTION_DOWN) and self.mode=='channels':
                self._move_channels(-1 if key==ACTION_UP else 1)
                self._input_trace('NATIVE_LIST_MOVED','native',action_id=key,button_code=raw)
                return
            elif key in (ACTION_PAGE_UP, ACTION_PAGE_DOWN) and self.mode == 'channels':
                if not self._page_channels(-1 if key == ACTION_PAGE_UP else 1):
                    self._remember_position()
            else:
                self._remember_position()
            self._render_rows()
            self._input_trace('NATIVE_LIST_MOVED','native',action_id=key,button_code=raw)
            return
        elif key == ACTION_SELECT:
            # Omega dispatches onControl BEFORE onAction(SELECT). Handling
            # SELECT here too would execute a second action in the new mode.
            marker.setProperty('XtreamMate.LastHandledKey', 'ok')
            self._input_trace('SELECT_ALREADY_CLICKED','native',action_id=key,button_code=raw)
            return
        elif key in (ACTION_UP, ACTION_DOWN):
            mapped = 'up' if key==ACTION_UP else 'down'
        else:
            from remote_profiles import mapped_action
            mapped = mapped_action(key, self._bindings)
        if mapped:
            marker.setProperty('XtreamMate.LastHandledKey', mapped)
            self.handle_command(mapped,source='native',action_id=key,button_code=raw)
        else:
            self._input_trace('ACTION_UNMAPPED','native',action_id=key,button_code=raw)

    def onControl(self, control):
        """Omega's click callback for programmatically created controls."""
        if not self._accept_input() or not self._drawn:
            return
        control_id = control.getId()
        if self._nav_rail.click(control_id):return
        if self.mode=='channels' and control_id==self._mini.list.getId():
            self._mini.focused=True;self._mini.selected=max(0,self._mini.list.getSelectedPosition());self._mini.command('ok');return
        if control_id == self.capture.getId():
            self.handle_command('ok',source='control',control_id=control_id)
            return
        if control_id == self.control.getId() and self.mode in ('groups','channels','guide'):
            self.handle_command('ok',source='control',control_id=control_id)
            return
        if self.mode == 'controls':
            for i,button in enumerate(self.main_buttons):
                if button.getId() == control_id:
                    if i not in self._main_indices: return
                    self._focus_main=i
                    self.handle_command('ok',source='control',control_id=control_id)
                    return
        elif self.mode == 'extras':
            for i,button in enumerate(self.extra_buttons):
                if button.getId() == control_id:
                    self._focus_extra=i
                    self.handle_command('ok',source='control',control_id=control_id)
                    return


def start_if_eligible(last_nonce):
    """Return overlay instance or None. Called in the service's main thread."""
    if not xbmc.Player().isPlayingVideo():
        return None
    session = session_from_property(xbmcgui.Window(10000).getProperty(SESSION_KEY))
    if not session or session['nonce'] == last_nonce:
        trace('dialog','NO_SESSION' if not session else 'SESSION_ALREADY_HANDLED',marker=bool(session))
        return None
    from portals import get_by_id
    portal = get_by_id(session['pid'])
    if not portal or portal.get('type') != 'xtream' or not portal.get('enabled',True):
        trace('dialog','PORTAL_UNAVAILABLE',marker=True)
        return None
    try:
        candidate = LiveNavigator(portal, session['sid'])
        trace('dialog','CANDIDATE_CREATED',channels=len(candidate.channels),catalog=candidate._catalog_ready)
        if candidate.owns_playback(): return candidate
        candidate.close()
        return None
    except Exception as exc:
        trace('dialog','CONSTRUCTION_FAILED')
        warn('XCMate navigator cannot start: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__))
        return None

"""Shared live navigator for M3U/Stalker, with explicit InfoTag ownership.

Provider link creation happens on one worker. Only the service thread applies
completed tune requests; stale requests and foreign playback never receive play.
"""
import json
import threading
import time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import xbmc
import xbmcgui
import xbmcplugin
from live_overlay import LiveNavigator,SESSION_KEY,session_from_property,announce,trace


def browse(router,portal):
    from library_index import Reader
    from app_routes import add_index_item,_end
    from epg import load_cache
    from epg_sources import configuration
    from epg_views import resolve_guide
    from source_adapters import for_portal
    from catalog_sync import request
    reader=Reader(portal['id']);cid=router._params.get('cid')
    request(portal,'live',priority=1)
    xbmcplugin.setContent(router._handle,'videos')
    if cid is None:
        for g in reader.groups('live'): router._add_dir(g['title'],router.url(action='source_live',pid=portal['id'],cid=g['cid']))
        router._add_dir('XCMate · '+__import__('localization').tr(32430),router.url(action='groups_manager',pid=portal['id']))
    else:
        try: offset=max(0,int(router._params.get('offset',0)))
        except ValueError: offset=0
        rows,total=reader.page('live',category=cid,offset=offset,limit=48)
        cache=load_cache(portal['id']);mappings=configuration(portal['id'])['mappings'];adapter=for_portal(portal)
        for row in rows:
            info=resolve_guide(cache,row.get('epg_channel_id',''),row['sid'],client=adapter,mappings=mappings)
            from app_routes import guide_plot
            add_index_item(router,portal,'live',row,dict(Now=info['now'],Next=info['next'],plot=guide_plot(info)))
        from app_routes import paging
        paging(router,total,offset,action='source_live',cid=cid)
    _end(router)


def play(router,portal,direct=False):
    from library_index import Reader
    from source_adapters import for_portal
    from player import build_playable_item
    from live_recovery import tag_live_item
    sid=str(router._params.get('sid') or portal.get('start_stream_id') or '')
    reader=Reader(portal['id']);record=reader.get('live',sid) if sid else None
    if direct and record is None:
        rows,_=reader.page('live',limit=1);record=rows[0] if rows else None
    if not record or portal.get('type') not in ('m3u','stb'):
        if not direct: xbmcplugin.setResolvedUrl(router._handle,False,xbmcgui.ListItem())
        return
    # This is a plugin interpreter, never the overlay's input callback.
    try:
        url,headers=for_portal(portal).play_uri('live',record['sid'])
        session=announce(portal['id'],record['sid'],record['name'])
        item=build_playable_item(url,title=record['name'],logo='',headers=headers)
        if not tag_live_item(item,session): raise RuntimeError('Kodi live identity unavailable')
        if direct:
            from app_routes import _end
            _end(router);xbmc.Player().play(item.getPath(),item)
        else: xbmcplugin.setResolvedUrl(router._handle,True,item)
    except Exception as exc:
        trace('dialog','SOURCE_PLAY_FAILED',exception_class=type(exc).__name__)
        if not direct: xbmcplugin.setResolvedUrl(router._handle,False,xbmcgui.ListItem())
        xbmcgui.Dialog().notification('XCMate',type(exc).__name__)


class SourceNavigator(LiveNavigator):
    def __init__(self,portal,initial_sid=''):
        from source_adapters import for_portal
        self._source_pool=ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1)
        self._source_lock=threading.Lock();self._source_result=None;self._source_serial=0;self._target_sid=initial_sid
        self._catalog_next=time.monotonic()+5;self._catalog_future=None;self._catalog_result=None;self._catalog_revision=None
        super().__init__(portal,initial_sid,client=for_portal(portal))
    def owns_playback(self):
        try:
            player=xbmc.Player()
            if self._closed or not player.isPlayingVideo(): return False
            from live_recovery import ITEM_ID
            raw=player.getVideoInfoTag().getUniqueID(ITEM_ID)
            tag=session_from_property(raw) if len(raw)<4096 else None
            current=session_from_property(xbmcgui.Window(10000).getProperty(SESSION_KEY))
            possible=[current]
            if time.monotonic()<self._tune_deadline: possible.append(self._previous_session)
            return bool(tag and tag['pid']==str(self.portal['id']) and
                any(value and all(tag.get(k)==value.get(k) for k in ('pid','sid','nonce','at')) for value in possible) and
                (tag['sid']==self.sid or tag['sid']==self._recent_sid and time.monotonic()<self._tune_deadline))
        except (AttributeError,ValueError,TypeError,RuntimeError): return False
    def _tune(self,channel):
        if not self.owns_playback(): return
        self._source_serial+=1;serial=self._source_serial
        self._target_sid=str(channel.extra['stream_id'])
        expected=session_from_property(xbmcgui.Window(10000).getProperty(SESSION_KEY))
        def resolve():
            if serial!=self._source_serial or self._closed: return
            try: result=(channel,self.xc.play_uri('live',str(channel.extra['stream_id'])),None)
            except Exception as exc: result=(channel,None,type(exc).__name__)
            with self._source_lock:
                if serial==self._source_serial and not self._closed: self._source_result=(serial,expected,result)
        self._source_pool.submit(resolve)
    def tick(self):
        if not self._closed and time.monotonic()>=self._catalog_next and (self._catalog_future is None or self._catalog_future.done()):
            self._catalog_next=time.monotonic()+5
            def read_catalog():
                try:
                    from library_index import Reader
                    state=Reader(self.portal['id']).state('live')
                    revision=(state or {}).get('revision')
                    if revision==self._catalog_revision: return
                    from source_adapters import for_portal
                    client=for_portal(self.portal)
                    groups=client.get_cached_catalog('get_live_categories');streams=client.get_cached_catalog('get_live_streams')
                    with self._source_lock:
                        if not self._closed: self._catalog_result=(revision,groups,streams,client._local_urls)
                except Exception as exc:
                    trace('catalog_performance','SOURCE_CACHE_READ_FAILED',exception_class=type(exc).__name__)
            self._catalog_future=self._source_pool.submit(read_catalog)
        with self._source_lock:
            catalog=self._catalog_result;self._catalog_result=None
        if catalog and not self._closed:
            self._catalog_revision,groups,streams,urls=catalog
            self.xc._local_urls=urls
            self.xc._catalog_snapshot={'get_live_categories':groups,'get_live_streams':streams}
            self._load_catalog_from_disk();self._list_key=None
            if self._drawn: self._render(focus=False)
        with self._source_lock: ready=self._source_result;self._source_result=None
        if ready and not self._closed:
            serial,expected,(channel,link,failure)=ready
            current=session_from_property(xbmcgui.Window(10000).getProperty(SESSION_KEY))
            if serial==self._source_serial and expected==current and self.owns_playback():
                if failure: trace('dialog','SOURCE_LINK_FAILED');xbmcgui.Dialog().notification('XCMate',failure)
                else:
                    from player import build_playable_item
                    uri,headers=link;sid=str(channel.extra['stream_id'])
                    # Base _tune retains established switching, tagging and input
                    # behavior. Pass the prepared URL including Kodi headers.
                    prepared=build_playable_item(uri,title=channel.name,logo='',headers=headers)
                    channel.url=prepared.getPath()
                    super()._tune(channel)
        super().tick()
    def _zap(self,step):
        rows,positions=self.index.selection(self.category_id,self.enabled)
        if not rows: return super()._zap(step)
        sid=str(self._target_sid or self.sid)
        pos=(positions.get(sid,0)+step)%len(rows)
        self._tune(rows[pos])
    def close(self):
        self._source_serial+=1
        super().close()
        self._source_pool.shutdown(wait=False,cancel_futures=True)


def start_if_eligible(last_nonce):
    session=session_from_property(xbmcgui.Window(10000).getProperty(SESSION_KEY))
    if not session or session['nonce']==last_nonce or not xbmc.Player().isPlayingVideo(): return None
    from portals import get_by_id
    portal=get_by_id(session['pid'])
    if not portal or not portal.get('enabled',True) or portal.get('type') not in ('m3u','stb'): return None
    try:
        candidate=SourceNavigator(portal,session['sid'])
        if candidate.owns_playback(): return candidate
        candidate.close()
    except Exception as exc: trace('dialog','SOURCE_CONSTRUCTION_FAILED',exception_class=type(exc).__name__)
    return None
